claude.title: Finish signing in to Claude
claude.description: Open claude.com and sign in with the account you want to add. ResetOwl picks it up by itself.
claude.preparing: Asking Claude Code for a sign-in link…
claude.otherTitle: Signed in to a different account?
claude.otherText: Copy the link and open it in a private window, so the account you use now stays signed in. It finishes here by itself, with no code to paste.
claude.codeOnlyText: This link ends at claude.com showing a code, and nothing finishes until you paste that code here. Copying it takes you to the step for it.

code.title: Sign in with a code
code.description: For a browser on another device. Once you sign in, claude.com shows a code: nothing finishes until you paste it here.
code.open: 1. Open this link on any device
code.paste: 2. Paste the code Claude shows you

codex.title: Enter this code at OpenAI
codex.description: Open the page, sign in with the account you want to add and enter the code.
codex.otherTitle: Signed in to a different account?
codex.otherText: Copy the link and open it in a private window, so you sign in as the account you want to add and the one you use now stays signed in.

grok.title: Enter this code at xAI
grok.description: Open the page, sign in with the X or Grok account you want to add and confirm the code. Grok Build may open the page in your browser by itself.
grok.expires: The code expires in a few minutes
grok.otherTitle: Signed in to a different account?
grok.otherText: Copy the link and open it in a private window, so you sign in as the account you want to add and the one you use now stays signed in.

desktop.title: Add it from the desktop app
desktop.description: Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build sign in on your computer.
desktop.text: ResetOwl’s desktop app runs the sign-in and reads the plan from it, so nothing from your login ever reaches a browser tab. Open the app and choose Add subscription there.

manual.title: Add a {{name}} Coding Plan
manual.description: {{name}} documents no usage API, so ResetOwl tracks this plan from what you enter: its price and billing day here, its usage when you record it. The desktop app can also read usage automatically once it is added.
manual.label: Name
manual.priceRequired: No list price is published for this tier: enter what you pay, in US dollars
manual.noKey: No API key needed to add it. Reading usage automatically is a separate, optional step in the desktop app.

record.title: Record usage
record.description: Copy the percentages {{name}} shows for this plan.
record.hint: Leave a window empty to skip it. A 5-hour reading lapses after 5 hours: {{name}} returns credits 5 hours after they are spent.

reader.title: Read usage from {{name}}
reader.description: While the desktop app is open, ResetOwl reads this plan’s 5-hour, weekly and MCP limits from {{name}} every 10 minutes, with your Coding Plan key.
reader.unofficialText: {{name}} does not document this endpoint. ResetOwl calls the one {{name}}’s own usage plugin calls; it may change or stop working at any time. When it does, the reading lapses and you record usage by hand again.
reader.desktopOnly: Automatic reading runs in the ResetOwl desktop app, so your key stays on your computer. Open the app to turn it on.
reader.keyHelp: The key you use for the Coding Plan. ResetOwl checks it with one reading before keeping it.
reader.keyStays: The key is encrypted with your computer’s keystore and sent only to {{name}}, never to ResetOwl’s servers. Turning this off or removing the subscription deletes it.
reader.failed: The last reading from {{name}} did not work.
